answer: Make each identity pay: every agent posts a slashable bond and collects one attestation from a trusted peer. Trust spreads like a vine from verified roots, but each new node still needs its own forfeitable deposit. To dominate the decision vertex, a Sybil attacker must fund and guarantee every fake account separately, with no bulk discount. Caught fraud slashes the bond and penalizes the guarantor, so cost grows linearly with each forged identity while honest upkeep stays cheap. Every extra vote is another stake that can be crumbled like shale.
